name: Shou
source:
A shy and reserved junior high school student. He's an extreme pessimist who feels uneasy about his surroundings changing.

His hobby is drawing. Because of his unique paintings, he's viewed as strange by those around him.

[From [url=http://mintwings.web.fc2.com/m01/character.html]official website[/url]]
